notes: Run separately as --path a then --path b, 20 s apart, so each produced its own artefact file and so the two member-smoke logins were spaced well clear of the 5/min limiter. Both runs are pre-open best cases and must not be quoted as member numbers. One thing worth carrying into item 10: on this quiet tape path B rendered picks (picks_ms=754) with a clean 5-request shape -- so the bimodal no-picks behaviour item 13 chases did NOT reproduce here, which is consistent with it being tape- or roll-dependent rather than deterministic.
